goal: Build a continuous MCP discovery feeder daemon that sources new MCP server candidates from npm (keyword mcp-server) and GitHub (topic mcp-server), deduplicates against existing mcp_server_registry entries by server_id, and inserts new candidates with status PENDING_SCAN via WriteService POST /write. Must run every 30 minutes, log discovery counts per source, emit a mesh_event of type discovery_batch with candidate count on each cycle. Target: 500+ new unique MCPs per day to keep signal_analyser queue non-empty toward the 20k assessed MCPs goal.
constraints: Deduplicate by server_id (blake2s hash of name+url)
Write via WriteService POST /write to http://127.0.0.1:8772/write not direct DuckDB
Must not re-queue already scored servers where trust_score IS NOT NULL
Rate limit max 60 npm API calls per minute
Use ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING not INSERT OR IGNORE for DuckDB compat
success_criteria: Script runs without error for one full 30-min cycle
At least one discovery_batch event appears in mesh_events
antipatterns: INSERT OR IGNORE - use ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING instead
Direct DuckDB writes - always use WriteService
Crashing on single source failure - log and continue
